source_caption:
Director Paul Thomas Anderson originally wanted to adapt Thomas Pynchon’s complex 1990 novel Vineland way back in the early 2000s. After years of struggling to crack a direct adaptation, Anderson decided to completely deconstruct the concept. He took the core father-daughter dynamic from the book and mashed it together with two entirely separate original script ideas he had been outlining: an action-heavy “car-chase movie” and a gritty story about a “female revolutionary.” The resulting hybrid narrative became the most expensive and ambitious project of Anderson’s career, boasting a massive $130–175 million budget, and ultimately went on to sweep the 2026 Academy Awards with major wins including Best Picture and Best Director.

One Battle After Another (2025), written and directed by Paul Thomas Anderson, starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Sean Penn, Benicio del Toro, Regina Hall, Teyana Taylor, and Chase Infiniti. A washed-up, paranoid former revolutionary living off the grid with his self-reliant teenage daughter is forced back into a dangerous, explosive conflict when his corrupt military nemesis resurfaces after sixteen years.

source_details.synopsis: One Battle After Another is a 2025 American epic action-comedy thriller film written, directed, and produced by Paul Thomas Anderson. Inspired by the 1990 novel Vineland by Thomas Pynchon, the film's ensemble cast includes Leonardo DiCaprio, Sean Penn, Benicio del Toro, Regina Hall, Teyana Taylor, and Chase Infiniti, in her film debut. The film follows a drug using washed-up former revolutionary who is thrust back into the conflict when an amoral tenacious counterterrorist agent resurfaces after sixteen years to bring them to justice to cover his past sins.
